title: Starter: Era NES
summary: A neutral NES-style screen to copy, built like the hardware builds one: a nametable of 8x8 tiles, an attribute table of 16x16 sub-palette blocks over a shared backdrop, and a short sprite list, all in 2C02 master-palette colours. Placeholders only (a status bar, a plain sky with a dithered band, a flat far strip, flat ground, a foreground strip, one platform, one 16x16 marker sprite); its frame passes `pixelate check --era nes`.
request: No user request: a new starter planned in docs/PLAN-library.md section 6.2 (`starter-era-nes`, script runtime, status starter): an empty piece for the era mode, held to the NES limits, that renders and passes the gate empty.
